name: Horror Night
description: Always night, a much darker world where your light radius matters, permanent rain and snow, and (with the Horror Night plugin) phantom monsters, lightning and thunder.
author: Latedozer

config.name: Always night
config.description: Every time of day uses the night lighting.

config.name: Overlay rain / snow (not needed with the plugin)
config.description: A visual-only rain and snow overlay. The Horror Night plugin now drives the game's real weather instead, so leave this off unless you run without the plugin.

config.name: Darkness %
config.description: How much ambient light to remove on top of vanilla night (0 = vanilla night, 95 = near pitch black).

config.name: Moonlight cap
config.description: Upper limit for the main sky light. Vanilla Act 1 night is 4.5; lower is darker.

config.name: Monster visibility %
config.description: Monsters have their own fill light that shows them even in the dark. Lower this to hide them until they enter your light.

config.name: Light radius reach %
config.description: Reach of the light around your character (100 = vanilla). Lower means you see less around you.

config.name: Gentler towns
config.description: Acts 2-5 towns lose at most 20% of their light. (The Rogue Encampment shares the Act 1 outdoor lighting and cannot be separated.)

config.name: Phantom monsters (needs the Horror Night plugin)
config.description: Adds the false-monster rows that the d2rl-horror-night plugin spawns: unkillable, they drain life without killing, and vanish after a random time. Timing and strength are set in the plugin's horror-night.toml.

config.name: Lightning bolts (needs the Horror Night plugin)
config.description: Adds the harmless lightning bolt the plugin drops near you during storms. It lights up the area around it for a moment.

config.name: Lightning light radius
config.description: How far each bolt lights up the dark (vanilla Thunder Storm bolt: 10). Raise it for a wider flash.

config.name: Lightning lights the whole sky (needs the Horror Night plugin)
config.description: Turns the unused daytime lighting of stormy outdoor areas into the lit-by-lightning look that the plugin flashes for a split second. Only with Always night on. Turn this off if you remove the plugin, or daytime will look like a permanent flash.

config.name: Flash brightness
config.description: Strength of the sky light at the peak of a flash (vanilla daylight is 13.5).

config.name: Flash ambient %
config.description: Ambient light at the peak of a flash (vanilla daylight is 40).

config.name: Fog thickness %
config.description: Adds dark distance fog and a low ground fog everywhere (0 = vanilla fog only).

config.name: Townsfolk among the dead (needs the plugin)
config.description: Some undead phantoms carry the name of someone from that act's town. When one appears the plugin starts a haunting: your life orb reads 1 and nearby corpses get back up.

config.name: Music volume %
config.description: 100 = vanilla. Lower lets the ambience carry the mood.

config.name: Ambient volume %
config.description: Volume of the world's own ambient loops and noises (100 = vanilla).
